description: Western astrology current transits against a natal chart. Tropical zodiac (no ayanamsa). "chart" returns the full transit chart overlay. "positions" returns current planetary positions in tropical signs. "aspects" returns current transit aspects (conjunction, opposition, trine, square, sextile) to natal planets with orbs. Vedika Ephemeris computed. Cost: $0.064/call.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

transitDateTime.description: Transit date/time in ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

type.description: chart=full transit overlay (default). positions=current planets. aspects=transit-to-natal aspects with orbs.

name: vedika_western_transits
